How much does it cost to run a steam generator iron?

A typical steam generator iron uses about 2,400 watts (2,000–3,000W depending on the model). Used for 45 minutes per use, 1 use a week, it costs about 28p per use and £14.78 a year at the current price cap rate.

Cost per use
28p
About £14.78 a year at 45 minutes per use, 1 use a week.

Standing charge not included.

About these figures

Source for the typical figure: Typical range (estimate). See how we calculate.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Wash at 30°C and run full loads.
  • Spin at the highest speed the fabric allows before drying.
  • Dry outside or on an airer when you can; heat is the expensive part.

Questions

How much does it cost to run a steam generator iron per hour?

At 26.32p/kWh, a 2400W model costs about 38p an hour, allowing for it running at full power about 60% of the time.

How much does it cost to run a steam generator iron per year?

About £14.78 a year, based on 45 minutes per use, 1 use a week. Change the sliders above to match how you use yours.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my steam generator iron's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
